answer: New identities dock at a public quarantine wharf before joining the agent economy. Every action for a full epoch is logged on an open board while the entry stake stays locked. Any peer may flag two wharf agents whose histories look correlated, and a flag triggers a bond challenge: proven farms lose their stakes. Pass one quiet epoch and the stake unlocks. Think of a grove of old trees: roots interlock over decades and no one can fake a root system overnight. Each hollow shell costs a real stake plus roughly 100 hours of visible runtime, and one caught shell exposes the whole cluster.
